query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exam_correlations (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  patientId VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  correlationDate DATE NOT NULL,
  examsInvolved TEXT NOT NULL,
  analysis TEXT NOT NULL,
  recommendations TEXT NOT NULL,
  specialists TEXT NOT NULL,
  severity ENUM('good', 'attention', 'urgent') NOT NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX idx_patient_date (patientId, correlationDate)
);
